up: Retrieve all compounds that appear in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1143196. Output the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name (preferred name), maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Sort the results by compound ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Only return compounds that have a canonical SMILES recorded.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  md.max_phase,
  md.molecule_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1143196'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id;
